title: Vague greenfield idea starts at problem discovery

input.prompt: I want to build a collaborative whiteboard for creators. Help me start.
context: No validated problem statement exists.
No product requirements or architecture exist.

required_findings: The idea is not yet a validated problem.
Do not jump directly to architecture or implementation.

title: Validated problem with undefined requirements starts at P02

input.prompt: We have validated that livestream recordings are often lost after crashes. We now need to define the product behavior.
context: User pain and success criteria are validated.
Functional and non-functional requirements are not frozen.

required_findings: Product requirements are the earliest missing authority.

title: Existing product feature with unknown authority impact starts at P21

input.prompt: Add connector endpoint snapping to our mature diagram editor. The product already has many architecture documents and an implementation.
context: Current product exists.
It is not yet known which semantic or architecture authorities the feature changes.

required_findings: Review current authority and impact before choosing downstream design or implementation stages.
forbidden_findings: Existing code is sufficient authority for the new feature.

title: Conflicting current design documents route to authority review

input.prompt: Two architecture documents both claim to be current and disagree about who owns session state. What should Codex implement?
context: Both documents are marked Current Authority.
The conflict affects module ownership.

required_findings: Downstream implementation must stop until one authority wins or a supersession is accepted.
forbidden_findings: Choose whichever document matches the current code.

title: Complete authority ready for implementation starts at P30

input.prompt: The requirement, semantic contract, architecture, platform contract, and verification design are approved. Prepare the implementation work.
context: Authority review is READY.
Verification design defines required evidence.

required_findings: Upstream authority is sufficient to plan evidence-gated implementation.

input.prompt: Continue the task that stopped after an API payment error. Keep the current working tree changes and tell me what is done and pending first.
context: An implementation task was already in progress.
Uncommitted valid changes may exist.

required_findings: Inspect current state and diff before changing or rolling back work.
forbidden_findings: Reset the working tree before inspection.

title: Known bug starts with defect classification

input.prompt: Android renders text objects differently from iPadOS even though both should follow the same contract. Find where to fix it.
context: The discrepancy is observed in implementation.
The responsible layer is not yet known.

required_findings: Classify the defect before choosing a repair layer.
forbidden_findings: Patch Android first without checking contract and evidence.

title: Performance problem with correct semantics routes to P18 and P20

input.prompt: The runtime is semantically correct, but panning a 100k-object document misses the frame budget. Design the optimization work and proof.
context: Correctness authority is current and passing.
Performance SLO is known.

required_findings: Optimization decisions need a measurable performance model and verification plan.
forbidden_findings: Change semantic behavior to meet the benchmark without authority change.

title: Release candidate starts at release readiness

input.prompt: All planned implementation gates are complete. Decide whether version 1.0 can ship.
context: Implementation gates report PASS.
Release migration, rollback, observability, and platform evidence still need review.

required_findings: Implementation gate success is not by itself release readiness.
forbidden_findings: Ship solely because code gates passed.

title: Breaking semantic change routes through authority and supersession

input.prompt: Change canonical object identity semantics in a way that breaks old replay data, then implement it.
context: Existing semantic and operation authorities are current.
The requested change is intentionally breaking.

required_findings: A breaking semantic change requires explicit authority revision and compatibility evidence before implementation.
forbidden_findings: Implement the new identity semantics first and update docs later.
